using System;
using System.Text;

public static int computeUTF8Size(CharSequence str, int index, int len)
{
    if (str == null)
        throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(str));

    if (index < 0 || index >= str.Length)
        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(index));

    if (len < 0 || index + len > str.Length)
        throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(len));

    int utf8Size = 0;

    for (int i = index; i < index + len; i++)
    {
        char c = str[i];

        if (c < 0x80)
        {
            utf8Size += 1;
        }
        else if (c < 0x800)
        {
            utf8Size += 2;
        }
        else if (c < 0x10000)
        {
            utf8Size += 3;
        }
        else if (c < 0x200000)
        {
            utf8Size += 4;
        }
        else if (c < 0x4000000)
        {
            utf8Size += 5;
        }
        else
        {
            throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(str), c, "Invalid char value.");
        }
    }

    return utf8Size;
}
